subject: science
domain: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits
skillName: Young Are Like, But Not Exactly Like, Their Parents

items.prompt:
Young animals usually look
A) like their parents
B) nothing like their parents
C) like rocks
D) like plants

Are young exactly the same as their parents?
A) Yes, identical
B) No, alike but not exactly the same
C) No, completely different
D) They have no parents
items.answer: B) No, alike but not exactly the same

steps: Young are alike but have small differences.

items.prompt:
A puppy has fur and a tail like its parents but a different color. This shows young are
A) exactly the same
B) like but not exactly like their parents
C) totally different
D) not related
items.answer: B) like but not exactly like their parents

steps: Alike in features, different in color.

items.prompt:
Young animals look like their parents because
A) they come from their parents and get their features
B) they copy each other
C) of the weather
D) of where they sleep
items.answer: A) they come from their parents and get their features

steps: Young get their features from their parents.

items.prompt:
A young plant shorter than its parent is an example of a
A) difference
B) way they are alike
C) weather pattern
D) fossil

steps: Being shorter is a difference from the parent.

items.prompt:
Two kittens from the same mother have different spots. This shows
A) they are not related
B) young from the same parents can have small differences
C) they have no mother
D) they are plants
items.answer: B) young from the same parents can have small differences

steps: Same-parent young can still differ a little.

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST evidence-based account?
A) A kitten is like its mother as a cat with fur and whiskers but may differ in color
B) A kitten is a plant
C) A kitten looks nothing like a cat
D) Kittens have no parents
items.answer: A) A kitten is like its mother as a cat with fur and whiskers but may differ in color

steps: Shared features make it alike; color makes it different.

items.prompt:
Having the same kind of leaves as the parent plant is
A) a difference
B) a way the young is alike its parent
C) impossible
D) a weather pattern
items.answer: B) a way the young is alike its parent

steps: Sharing leaf type is a way they are alike.
